Description: When the husks stop moving you find what they were guarding: a survey camp, long abandoned. A bedroll, a cold lantern, and a leather satchel stitched with a mushroom sigil. A name is burned into the strap: MOREL.

Replies.ReplyText: Read the field notes and pack the satchel.
Replies.SsText: Morel was a myceliumancer, a scholar who believed the Mycelium could be spoken to rather than fought. The journal's last page reads: "The Mycelarch listens. I am going down to answer it. If I do not return, follow my waymarkers to its throne." Tucked in the satchel are a few coins.
Whoever Morel was, his things are none of your business. You move on.
